nativeAbsolutePath.$comment: Value is canonical unpadded base64url. Consumers additionally validate the decoded payload is at most 65536 native bytes, contains no NUL code unit, and is absolute for its tagged platform. Windows device and extended-length namespace forms are not admitted.

scanObjectIdentity.$comment: All IDs must belong to the enclosing ScannedEntry.scanId. The root has entryId == scanRootId and no parentId; a child has entryId != scanRootId, a parentId distinct from entryId, and the same scanRootId as its root. JSON Schema validates each ID shape; consumers must enforce these cross-field invariants.

nativePathComponent.$comment: parentId is absent only for the scan root and is required for every non-root ancestor and target entry by the enclosing nativeLocator/scannedEntry constraints.

nativeLocatorEvidence.$comment: All component IDs must belong to the enclosing ScannedEntry.scanId. scanRoot and entry must match identity.scanRootId and identity.entryId. New live output includes scanRootAbsolutePath; legacy/imported v1 records may omit it and are non-executable. A root has no parentId and an empty parentReopenRecipe. Every child recipe begins with scanRoot and continues in ancestor order through the immediate parent; every non-root component carries its direct parentId and the target parent must match identity.parentId. The entry nativeBasename, objectType, identity evidence, and metadataFingerprint must match ScannedEntry. JSON Schema validates structure and lossless encodings; consumers enforce ID equality, parent-link continuity, native basename grammar, absolute-path grammar, and current-platform matching.

identity.description: Required on new live scanner output. It may be absent only on legacy or imported records; absence never permits synthesizing identity from displayPath.

nativeLocator.description: Required on new live scanner output. It may be absent only on legacy or imported records; absence never permits synthesizing a reopen recipe from displayPath.

directoryIdentity.$comment: Only the scanEntryId branch is trusted identity evidence. Acceptance of the legacy branch is wire compatibility, never authority.

legacyDirectoryIdentity.description: Legacy wire-compatible value. It is untrusted and must never be treated as an object identity or promoted from a display path.

directoryAggregate.$comment: When directoryIdentity uses scanEntryId, its encoded scan component must match scanId. Consumers must enforce that cross-field invariant before trusting it.

planResultData.$comment: Output-only human-review projection. This JSON is never accepted as a DeletionPlan, ApprovalRecord, ExecutionAuthorization, or PreflightPermit. Cross-field count, digest/fingerprint, aggregate-risk, expiry-order, and permanent-risk invariants are also enforced by the typed protocol validator.

cargoWorkspaceTargetDirDeclaration.$comment: The public projection intentionally contains no target-dir value, relativePath, or relativeComponents. A known declaration identifies only its workspace config source.

cargoEnvironmentVariableEvidence.$comment: Only variable presence is observable. Values are never admitted into this wire shape.

cargoConfigScopeV1.$comment: Read-only source ledger. Per-file observations are not an atomic pair unless pairSnapshot is stable_snapshot; precedenceComplete remains false for the current production collector.

cargoDetectTargetDirEvidence.$comment: The current production collector cannot establish full Cargo precedence, so it never exports a known target directory or a relative path.

cargoDetectObservation.$comment: A report-only observation is not a Candidate, plan, approval, or execution authorization. Unknown fields are rejected.
